titleEn: Quantum mechanics: the strange world behind matter
summaryEn:
In the familiar world, an object has a fairly definite position, cannot spontaneously pass through a wall, and two objects far apart cannot share strange instantaneous correlations.

But when we go down to the atomic and subatomic scale, that intuition starts to stop working. Electrons, photons and quantum systems follow rules very different from those of objects in everyday life.

This is the world of quantum mechanics.
